# Vendored FFmpeg n6.0 headers (headers only)

Used by `thumb_shim.cpp` to call the FFmpeg 6.0 that is already inside the APK
(`libmediainfo.so` from `app/libs/nextlib-mediainfo-local.aar`, `Lavf60.3.100`) through
`dlopen`/`dlsym`. Nothing here is compiled into a second FFmpeg; no FFmpeg code is linked.

- Source: https://github.com/FFmpeg/FFmpeg tag `n6.0` (commit `ea3d24bbe3c58b171e55fe2151fc7ffaca3ab3d2`),
  headers only: the 32 files the shim includes transitively (from `clang -MM`).
- `libavutil/avconfig.h` is generated by FFmpeg's `configure`; hand-written here for
  arm64-v8a / armeabi-v7a (little-endian, fast unaligned access). It does not change any struct layout.
- Versions: libavcodec 60.3.100, libavutil 58.2.100, libswscale 7.1.100.
- Licence: LGPL-2.1-or-later (see `COPYING.LGPLv2.1`).

**The shim relies on these structs matching the FFmpeg inside the AAR.** `libmediainfo.so` exports no
version symbol, so the build pins the AAR's `libmediainfo.so` SHA-256 (see `app/build.gradle.kts`,
`verifyNextlibFfmpegPin`). If the AAR changes, re-verify the FFmpeg version and update these headers.
